notes: Imaging calendar (Tools → 📅): imaging nights, projects and plans, read from the pictures – now also Nikon NEF pictures and SER videos.

Observer's name: the program asks at start-up who is imaging (optional; Skip keeps the name, earlier names can be picked, the question can be turned off in Tools → ⚙ Settings → General). The night folder becomes 2026-11-16_Name, the FITS header gets OBSERVER, and the calendar can show one observer's nights.
Connected devices at a glance: a green frame round the panel (blue in night mode, yellow while connecting), a dot in its title and a line under its toolbar button.

Comets as targets: by name in the Telescope panel, in the sequencer, on the phone's sky map (☄ button) and in the target assistant (Comets filter, plans with 60 s exposures). The comet's place is computed when it is used.
Second main camera: a monitor window can take a FITS series (📷 Capture a series) at the same time as the main camera – cooled cameras 16-bit, video cameras raw frames.
⚙ Settings (formerly Extra) on pages of their own: General, Safety, Remote, Devices and program.

Astrometry: ✎ Annotate in its own window with a preview (Accept / Cancel): RA/Dec grid, north and east arrows, scale bar, a target information box with selectable lines. ⭐ Comparison stars from APASS DR9, Gaia DR3 or AAVSO's sequence: a supernova's or variable star's magnitude from several comparison stars (ensemble), and an AAVSO extended report.
Terms of use: final version 1.1 (no longer a draft).
